# Evaluation report

**Read this first.** All documents are synthetic (a fictional project) and were generated by the same author who wrote the checks. These results show the logic is consistent and the evidence chain is intact; they are *not* an accuracy figure for real drawings, which must be measured on real projects (pilot Week 2).

- dev = seed 0, all 27 defect kinds, used while building the rules.
- test = seeds 1-40, inspected during rule development and error analysis.
- holdout = seeds 41-60, generated and scored only in the final run of this version.
- metric = seeds 61-70, the same project family drawn in millimetres at 1:100.
- clean = 5 negative controls with zero seeded defects; every shipped finding would be a false positive.

All splits come from one generator, so they test robustness to variation, not to unseen drafting styles.

## Evidence and hallucination controls

- Evidence localisation (holdout): 266/266 detected defects have an evidence anchor on the ground-truth location (1.0).
- Citation verification (all splits): every shipped finding carries only re-verified anchors; anchors checked 2754, verified 2754, findings rejected by the gate 0.
- Negative controls: 0 shipped findings on 5 clean sets (every one would be a false positive).
- Abstentions (needs_review, holdout): 20 items, 20 on deliberate ambiguity traps ('TYP.' without a count). Trap violations (confident claims on traps): 0.
- Determinism: 2 runs on the dev set, identical output = True.
- Hallucination injection (mock LLM on dev set): 25 fabricated conflicts injected across 5 spec-section requests; 25 stopped by the evidence gate, 0 shipped (catch rate 1.0). 3/3 correct conflicts passed and corroborated the rule findings.
- Known limit, measured: 5 *real* quotes attached to *false* claims were also injected; 5 passed the gate (as tier probable). The gate proves a citation exists where cited; it cannot prove the citation supports the claim. That is why LLM findings are never 'confirmed', are routed to an engineer, and why the reviewer reject rate is tracked in production.

Mean run time per set: 1.36 s (max 1.99 s, 76 sets).
